evidence: Has RPC/REST/ZMQ label; modifies src/httpserver.cpp, src/bitcoin-cli.cpp, and RPC bind/connect arguments.
rationale: Adds UNIX domain socket support to Bitcoin Core's HTTP RPC server and `bitcoin-cli`, closing a long-standing feature request (#5029) open since 2014. It addresses an interface gap that previously forced node operators to rely on TCP loopback connections and IP allowlists instead of filesystem permissions.
